branchless_polymod.note: bech32Polymod feeds every value through one polymodStep that xors each generator term under a mask built from its state bit (no data-dependent branches, constants inlined) instead of a 5-iteration loop with a branch per term.

charset_table.note: toBytes looks each character up in a 256-entry reverse table built once at package init instead of an IndexByte scan of the 32-character charset, and fills a presized slice instead of appending.

convertbits_acc.note: ConvertBits keeps pending bits in one accumulator and emits a full output group per inner step (the BIP173 reference algorithm) instead of moving at most a few bits per inner iteration; high input bits are still discarded, and padding and incomplete-group errors are unchanged.
